book.title: THE METAMORPHOSIS
book.subtitle: A CEFR A1 Educational Adaptation of Franz Kafka
book.author: Franz Kafka
book.adaptation_note_pt: Adaptação educacional com inglês simplificado. O enredo, a atmosfera sombria, os conflitos, a filosofia e o final da obra são preservados.

week.title: The Family Moves On

opening_illustration.alt_text: Gregor sits alone in a darker, cluttered room filled with boxes and stored objects while warm light from the family rooms is visible beyond the doorway.

part_illustrations.alt_text: The tired Samsa family works and studies under warm light while Gregor watches from his dark bedroom doorway.
Gregor sits among boxes and unused furniture while Grete leaves food quickly and walks away without looking at him.
Three serious lodgers dine while the Samsa family serves them and Gregor watches from a distant doorway.
Grete plays the violin in the illuminated living room while Gregor listens from the darkness.
Gregor slowly leaves his cluttered room and moves toward Grete and the sound of her violin.
A lodger points at Gregor, Grete lowers her violin and everyone turns toward the doorway in shocked silence.

before_you_read: Can music change the way you feel?
How do people feel when nobody notices them?
Can a family continue changing even when one person stays in the same place?
story: The apple remains in his body, and he becomes weaker.
He cannot move as easily as before.
His family has a new routine now.
He wears his dark uniform every day.
She sews clothes for other people.
She works during the day and studies at night.
Gregor watches them when his bedroom door is open.
Sometimes the family sits together in the living room.
Gregor stays in the darkness of his room.
But he is not really part of their life anymore.
At first, Grete took good care of him.
She still brings food, but she does it quickly.
Sometimes she does not look at him.
Sometimes she leaves the room without cleaning it well.
Gregor understands that Grete is tired.
But he also understands something painful.
The family starts putting things there.
The room becomes a place for things that have no other place.
A new cleaning woman comes to the apartment.
She is not very afraid of Gregor.
Sometimes she opens the door and looks at him.
Gregor does not know what to think about her.
She talks to him in a simple, direct way.
She does not treat him like Grete does.
But she does not treat him like Gregor Samsa either.
So they rent one room to three men.
They want the apartment to be clean.
They want everything to be correct.
The Samsa family tries to please them.
But now the lodgers have an important place in it.
Gregor has less and less space.
One evening, the three lodgers are eating in the living room.
Gregor moves closer to the door.
Gregor forgets the pain in his body.
Before his transformation, he wanted to help Grete study music.
He wanted to send her to a music school.
He cannot say: “Your music is beautiful.”
He cannot say: “I wanted to help you.”
He moves toward the living room.
He wants to be closer to the music.
For a moment, Gregor does not think about fear.
He does not think about his body.
He only thinks about Grete and her violin.
Then one of the lodgers sees him.
But this time, Gregor is not thinking about work.
He is not thinking about money.

visual_reflection.title: Grete Plays the Violin
visual_reflection.alt_text: Grete plays the violin under warm light while the lodgers and family listen. Gregor is partly visible in the darker doorway, drawn toward the music.
questions: Why is the difference between light and darkness important?

items: The three ______ live in the apartment.
Gregor remembers an old ______ about Grete.

reading_comprehension.question: Why is Gregor weaker now?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: Because he is still hurt after the apple attack.

reading_comprehension.question: What job does Mrs. Samsa do at home?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: She sews clothes for other people.

reading_comprehension.question: What does Grete do during the day?
How does Grete's care for Gregor change?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: She becomes more tired and gives him less attention.

reading_comprehension.question: What happens to Gregor's room?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: It becomes a storage room for boxes, furniture and other objects.

reading_comprehension.question: Why does the family have three lodgers?
Why is the music important to Gregor?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: It moves him emotionally and connects him to Grete and his human memories.

reading_comprehension.question: What did Gregor want to do for Grete before his transformation?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: He wanted to help her study music / send her to music school.

reading_comprehension.question: What happens when the lodgers see Gregor?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: They become upset and the music stops.

true_false.statement: Gregor's room becomes cleaner and more comfortable.
The family rents a room because they need money.
The cleaning woman is very afraid of Gregor.
Gregor leaves his room because he wants to attack the lodgers.

reflection.title: Think About the Story
reflection.prompt: What does Gregor's reaction to music tell us about him?

items: The lodgers ______ a room in the apartment.

speaking_mission.title: What Makes Gregor Human?
sentence_starters: I think he is still human because...
speaking_mission.challenge: Is a human body necessary to be human?

writing_mission.title: Gregor and the Music
writing_mission.instruction: Write about what Gregor hears, feels and remembers when Grete plays.

questions: Gregor wants to be close to Grete. Why can't he simply join the family?

kafkas_question.prompt: Has Gregor become less important than the things the family needs?

deeper_question.prompt: Who looks more human in this scene: Gregor or the people who only see a problem?

prediction.context: The lodgers can see Gregor. The music stops. The family is afraid of what happens next.
prediction.question: What do you think Grete will say?

learning_outcomes: Understand how the family has changed.
Explain why the violin scene is important.

next_week.teaser: Gregor wants to be close to Grete. But Grete is about to make the most important decision of the story. The final metamorphosis is not Gregor's body.
